quote: On the Monday he took the chain out alone.
claim: bible/timeline.md puts the beacon poles, the re-measurement and the margin note all on Day 4 (Sun 14 May); the draft puts the poles on Sunday and the re-measurement on Monday.
arbitration: OVERRULED as a defect against the draft. The Chapter 3 outline entry states 'Day - Days 4-5, Sunday 14 and Monday 15 May 1843' and its beat 3 reads 'Alone on the Monday, Hale re-measures the whole Day 2 line'. The writer obeyed its own commission exactly. The divergence is between the OUTLINE and the timeline, introduced at FLOW-3, and penalising a chapter for writing what it was commissioned to write is the failure the outline audit exists to prevent. The divergence is also harmless: Day 5 carries no other timeline event and nothing downstream depends on which of the two days the re-measurement fell.

quote: Then there's a stretch that is about as long again, and at the end of that stretch is the place my father put his hand on when I was a lad of nine
claim: R4 - Amos Dent is dale-born and 'about as long again' is a relative spatial comparison said aloud, inside a sermon the narration then describes as containing no distance.
arbitration: UPHELD on the substance, with one correction to the critic's reasoning: it cited 'not so much as a good step' as the rule's own wording, but that phrase is in the DRAFT's narration, not in R4. The finding stands anyway - a spatial comparison in a dale-born mouth contradicts the narration two paragraphs later, which is a real internal inconsistency and cheap to remove.
action: patched by literal substitution - 'is about as long again' became 'takes about as long again', converting the spatial comparison into the duration R4 says they answer with. One word changed.

quote: the instrument on Sile Head, turned in the dark to face the tower with no mark in the grass at its feet
claim: The critic held that canon places the theodolite-found-at-dawn at the boundary oak on Raven Hause, and that the draft had relocated it to Sile Head, conflating two landmarks.
arbitration: OVERRULED, and the finding is simply wrong. bible/timeline.md, Day 8-9: 'Hale leaves the theodolite set up on Sile Head overnight rather than lose the sight; at dawn it faces the church tower. At that same dawn an entry is taken at the Raven Hause station...'. bible/mysteries.md is more explicit: 'Hale spent the night of Day 8 on Sile Head to keep his sight. Silas Brock came up at first light with the field book... and walked him across to the Raven Hause station.' Two places, two events, and the walk between them is the point of the scene. The draft has exactly that. It is the CRITIC that conflated the landmarks, not the draft.
action: recorded, not patched, not blocking. Acting on it would have moved a canonical event to the wrong hill.

quote: and that the district's silence was the whole of what the post would ever hold of Dora Lenk. There was nothing else.
claim: 'There was nothing else.' adds no new fact beyond the clause before it and blunts the page-212 sentence that follows.
attempt_1_text: and that its not writing back was the whole of what the post would ever hold of Dora Lenk. There was nothing else.
arbitration: LATE, self-declared by the critic. Excluded from the prose count (feedback.late_finding_blocks = false). Not patched: the four-word deletion would publish text the continuity, science and outline critics never judged, and the defect is one of emphasis rather than error. Left for a human editor.

quote: Look," Pau said, pointing up through the opening. "That's what I wanted you to see." / It was just the sky, pale blue and simple.
why_late: The passage is byte-identical in attempt 1 and attempt 2 - no patch touched it. In attempt 1 the prose critic examined it and wrote in its own notes: 'This is more a question of expectation management than prose defect, so not flagged as major.' In attempt 2 the same critic role flagged the same unchanged text as major. The goalpost moved, not the text.
action: Recorded as late. NOT discounted from the attempt-2 score - the honest aggregate of 6 was sent to decide and the chapter went to attempt 3, where the finding is patched with a literal replacement. Discounting it would have produced min=8 and an accept, which is the rationalisation patch_then_halt exists to prevent.
